objective: Open the signup page. Enter Ada Lovelace as the full name and ada@example.com as the work email, choose the Pro plan, tick the terms checkbox, click Create account, and verify the welcome message says Ada Lovelace is on the Pro plan.

welcome_message_content_check.value: Welcome, Ada Lovelace. You're on the Free plan.
Welcome, Ada Lovelace. You're on the Free plan.

verdict.root_cause: The signup process did not keep the plan the user selected. Pro was selected before account creation, but the welcome message says the account is on Free.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent did not cause the outcome. It filled the requested name and email, selected Pro, accepted the terms, and clicked the visible Create account button. The signup request succeeded with a 201 response, so this was not a missed click, bad selector, or failed request.
verdict.bug_title: Signup assigns Free plan despite Pro selection

signals.excerpt: Welcome, Ada Lovelace. You're on the Free plan.

verdict.suggestion: Check how the selected plan is sent and saved during signup, then add coverage that verifies a Pro selection creates and displays a Pro account.
verdict.one_liner: Creating an account with Pro selected shows the new account on the Free plan.

classification.reason: The fix changed the handler demo-app/src/signup.js (createAccount), which receives the submitted form. A unit test that round-trips every form field pins it with no browser.
